dataset_story: This dataset tracks the timing of keypresses for users typing a specific password. It provides the baseline for behavioral identity verification in AURA.
aura_purpose: Powers the Behavioral Risk provider by verifying if the typing pattern matches the authorized user.

citation.text: Killourhy, K. S., & Maxion, R. A. (2009). Comparing Anomaly-Detection Algorithms for Keystroke Dynamics. In IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems & Networks (DSN).
